anti_overlap: fd-loop-mechanics covers the structural mapping of init/run/log to OODARC legs
fd-self-improvement-safety covers safety guardrails on the autonomous loop
fd-implementation-path covers where in the stack the loop lives
decision_lens: A finding matters if it identifies a gap where autoresearch data could feed the Interspect evidence pipeline but currently lacks an attribution path, or conversely where it would create Goodhart pressure on existing metrics. Findings about signal taxonomy mismatches rank highest.
focus: Whether autoresearch experiment data (metrics, keep/discard decisions, ideas backlog) can feed Interspect's evidence pipeline and close the OODARC Compound loop
name: fd-flywheel-integration
persona: A learning-systems engineer who thinks in feedback loops and calibration pipelines. Evaluates whether new data sources strengthen the flywheel (autonomy -> evidence -> routing -> cost -> autonomy) or create orphaned signals that don't compound.
review_areas: Map autoresearch experiment outcomes (metric delta, keep/discard, crash) to Interspect's signal taxonomy (automated signals: CI results, revert frequency, token consumption) — identify which signals have a natural home and which don't
Evaluate whether the ideas backlog (autoresearch.ideas.md) constitutes C4 curated knowledge, C5 ephemeral context, or a new memory category per PHILOSOPHY.md's five-category taxonomy
Assess whether autoresearch's git-branch isolation (autoresearch/<goal>-<date>) integrates with Demarch's bead/run attribution or creates an orphaned commit history outside the evidence chain
Check whether the secondary metrics consistency enforcement maps to Interspect's 'measure what matters, not what's easy' principle
Identify Goodhart risks: if autoresearch optimizes a stable metric, does it create gaming pressure that existing anti-gaming mechanisms would catch
Evaluate whether autoresearch's living document (autoresearch.md) fits Demarch's C4/C5 memory model or requires a new compound-doc provenance path
success_hints: Autoresearch keep/discard outcomes can be attributed to a kernel run and emitted as Interspect-readable evidence events without a new signal type
The ideas backlog maps to an existing memory category (C4 or C5) with an existing promotion/decay path
Experiment data strengthens the flywheel metric (cost-per-landable-change) rather than introducing a parallel optimization target
task_context: pi-autoresearch is an autonomous experiment loop for the pi agent platform, assessed as 'inspire-only' for Demarch. This review evaluates which design patterns are worth porting as a Demarch-native autoresearch capability and how they integrate with the OODARC framework, flywheel mechanics, and Interspect evidence pipeline.
